name: ShinyText-TS-TW
title: ShinyText
description: Two lines of grey text sit on black while a metallic white highlight travels through the letters. The band moves from one side to the other and repeats without pausing.
use: A short headline should catch the eye gently without a video or images.
avoid: It needs a dark backdrop to read well and the loop never fully rests.
a11y: The sheen loops forever with no prefers-reduced-motion check, which can distract light-sensitive readers. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Two lines of sans-serif copy on a plain black stage: a large grey sentence and a much smaller second line below it. The letters brighten to near-white inside a soft diagonal band that crosses them.
behaves: A diagonal white band drifts steadily across the text, lighting the letters it passes, then restarts once it leaves the far side. The sweep never settles.
customise: Text, speed, base and shine colours, gradient angle, yoyo reversal, hover pause, direction and a start delay are props.
weight: light: One text span whose background position is updated each frame; no extra nodes.
